name: BS Hamzići
_design_json: Same system as Sjednica (the design cannot change); the Hamzići design.json carries the Sjednica module, array, genset and tank values plus the site data.

pvgis._src: PVGIS API v5.3, SARAH3 with ERA5 temperature and wind, 2005-2023. Horizon from the PVGIS DEM (at most 2,7°, to the north). The lone tree 15-20 m SSE-SE of the tower (photo survey 08.09.2026) is NOT in the DEM; it is added as a user horizon by `python -m pvsim photo` (Phase 2).

array._src: Same array as Sjednica: 12 x iPV585-M2A, 2 strings x 6 (design cannot change). 45° adopted (Investor 11.09.2026); 60° is kept as the comparison column of the report. Azimuth 225° (true SW) from design.json.

issu._src: As sjednica.json: iSSU S4875G2 datasheet Figure 2, Vin = 330 V, digitised.

_src.model: As sjednica.json (PVGIS c-Si module model; see there).
_src.soiling_monthly: Assumption: a drier, dustier Herzegovina summer than Sjednica (karst, terra rossa, dry grass).
_src.snow_monthly: Assumption: 493 m in the Mediterranean belt, snow is rare and short-lived.
_src.other: mismatch, LID, wiring and optimizer as sjednica.json.

load._src: Preliminary: the same 1180 W / 1330 W as Sjednica, until the measured Hamzići DC load arrives (user decision 2026-09-11). Cooling ramp and aux (45 W including the always-on -48 V DC loads) as sjednica.json. The ramp matters more here: July/August mean 24,7 °C.

battery.label: 6 × 150 Ah LFP
battery._src: As sjednica.json: 6 x 150 Ah LFP = 48,6 kWh as stated in the Odluka (Investor, 11.09.2026); efficiencies are assumptions; 0,5 C is the Prilog I §4.6 setting, BMS maximum confirmed by the bidder.

control._src: As sjednica.json: DOD to Start 85 % (SMU default); stop SoC 60 % and minimum run 1 h are the TD requirement (Prilog I §4.6, Rev 9).

genset._src: As sjednica.json. At 493 m and 40 °C the derated prime is ≈12,3 kW, so the 9,5 kW cap leaves more margin than at Sjednica (to be confirmed in Hamzići 07-proracuni A.2).

limits._src: Prijedlog Odluke, Aneks 2 (the joint tender applies the same limits to both sites).

photos._src: Site visit 08.09.2026 12:11-12:17 CEST, Samsung Galaxy A55. EXIF carries the time and UTC offset but no GPS position and no compass heading, so orientation is checked by eye against the computed sun position, not read from the files.

array_position._src: Array centre relative to the tower centre (= slab centre): the middle of the 3 300 mm true-SW band between the slab (half-width 2,70 m) and the lease line, 4,35 m from the centre at bearing 225° (site_geometry.json; plan north = true NW, Investor 11.09.2026).

obstacles.name: stablo JJI-JI
obstacles._src: Photo survey 08.09.2026 (20260908_121243(1) and others): lone deciduous tree 7-9 m, 15-20 m SSE-SE of the tower. Bearing, distance, height and crown width are ESTIMATES from the photos, not a survey, so they are carried as ranges and bracketed. Opacity: leafless crown lets about half the beam through (Nov-Mar), full leaf blocks it (May-Sep) - an assumption.

stands._src: qp ≥ 1,20 kN/m² adopted as at Sjednica (one stand design for both sites); the certified 2017 project (JUS U.C7, vm,50,10 = 25 m/s) translates to BAS EN 1991-1-4 qp 0,69-0,96 kN/m². Plot from the certified 01_Situacija 1_200.dwg: lease 12 000 x 12 500 mm (k.č. 109/1 K.O. Hamzići), slab 5 400 mm centred. Google Maps (Investor 11.09.2026) puts plan north at true NW, so the stands stand in the true-SW band: 3 300 mm deep, 12 500 mm long. The 2x2 portrait field at 45° is 3,24 m deep and does not fit; the adopted 4x3L (4 stands of 1x3 landscape, same at both sites) is 2,43 m deep, leaving 0,87 m for the ICC360 and MTS behind it. Geometry: hamzici-hybrid-solar/cad/site_geometry.json.
